user.description: Set up stringing and print failure detection for one printer. One printer per setup run; add more printers later via "Add integration".

data.name: Printer name
data.mjpeg_url: Alternative: direct MJPEG URL of the printer

data_description.api_key: Sent as bearer token to api.mistral.ai. Camera images leave your local network.
data_description.mistral_model: e.g. mistral-medium-latest. Change here when Mistral releases a new vision model.
data_description.camera_entity: Preferred frame source: the chamber camera from the ha-bambulab integration.
data_description.mjpeg_url: Only needed if no camera entity is used (direct P1S stream).
data_description.print_state_entity: Required. Analysis only runs while the state (gcode_state) is in the running states (default: RUNNING,PAUSE). Without an entity no images are analysed (fail-closed, saves API cost).
data_description.notify_services: Default "Automatically": all detected companion apps are notified. Alternatively select a specific service.
data_description.bambu_device_id: Enables pause/resume/stop via ha-bambulab services and links the device pages.

error.no_frame_source: Provide either a camera entity or an MJPEG URL.

abort.already_configured: A printer with this name is already set up.

data_description.check_interval_sec: 20-300 s. Stringing develops slowly; 30-60 s is enough.
data_description.stringing_threshold: 40-80. Score from which a frame counts as stringing.
data_description.stringing_streak: 1-5. Alarm only after n consecutive frames above the threshold.
data_description.spaghetti_threshold: 50-90. Critical alarm immediately when exceeded (once per print).
data_description.warping_threshold: 40-80. Warping (lifting edges) is handled like stringing: streak + cooldown, informative notification.
data_description.layer_shift_threshold: 50-90. Layer shift is critical like spaghetti: immediate, once per print, part of auto pause.
data_description.stringing_cooldown_min: 5-60. At most one stringing notification per period. Also applies to warping.
data_description.auto_pause: Off by default (notify only). On spaghetti, pause_print is called via ha-bambulab.
data_description.api_key: Leave empty to keep the existing API key. Only fill in to change it.
data_description.snapshot_retention_days: 1-90. Older snapshots and score logs are deleted (latest.jpg is kept).
data_description.running_states: Default: RUNNING,PAUSE. Compared against the gcode_state attribute or the state (case-insensitive). PAUSE is included so paused prints keep being monitored.
data_description.pause_service: Service path, e.g. bambu_lab.pause_print. Target device is the configured ha-bambulab printer.
data_description.notify_services: "Automatically" notifies all detected companion apps; alternatively select a specific service.
data_description.preprocess_enabled: Enhances images before analysis: crop to print bed, increase contrast & sharpness. Makes fine strings more visible.
data_description.filament_type: Helps the model calibrate (PETG tends to string, ABS to warp). Empty = unknown.
data_description.nozzle_temp: Current nozzle temperature. Too hot → more stringing, too cold → adhesion issues. 0 = unknown.
data_description.min_confidence: Frames with lower confidence are discarded (not counted). Reduces false positives at 0.6–0.8.
data_description.smoothing_enabled: Smooths scores over multiple frames (Exponential Moving Average). Reduces short-term fluctuations.
data_description.smoothing_alpha: Higher = faster reaction to changes (0.3 = good default). Lower = more smoothing.
data_description.ensemble_enabled: First a fast/cheap model, then a more accurate model on uncertainty. Saves cost on clear cases, improves accuracy on borderline cases.
data_description.critical_ensemble_enabled: Benchmark-optimized: glm-5-3-flash (cheap) + mistral-medium-latest (fast). Critical defects (spaghetti, layer-shift) are ALWAYS checked by both models — maximum safety, no false negatives on critical errors! Costs ~0.46¢/scan.
data_description.plausibility_rules_enabled: OFF by default. Can correct obvious misclassifications (e.g. spaghetti on standing towers → stringing), but can also destroy correct answers. Benchmark: glm 77.9% → 64.3% accuracy. Only enable if false positives are a problem.

check_now.name: Check now
check_now.description: Immediately grab and analyze one frame of the selected printer, regardless of interval.

mute_for_print.name: Mute for current print
mute_for_print.description: Toggles muting for the running print (no push, no auto pause).

reset_detection.name: Reset detection
reset_detection.description: Resets streaks, detection flags, notification latches and cooldown timers. Muting is left untouched.

restart_required.title: Restart required after update
restart_required.description: The integration was updated to version {disk_version}, but version {loaded_version} is still loaded. Restart Home Assistant to activate the new version.

init.title: Restart Home Assistant
init.description: Version {disk_version} is installed, but version {loaded_version} is still active. Restart Home Assistant now?
